subject: Demo recap & proposed POC outline for SparkBank
messages:
From: Alice Ng <alice@sparkbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@sparkbank.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo follow-up: Redwood inference fit?

Thanks for the demo earlier today — really helpful. A quick recap from our side so we're aligned on next steps and what a successful POC would look like for SparkBank.

Key areas we care about from the demo:
- Low latency for conversational flows (customer support bot)
- Cost predictability for high-volume inference (peak traffic events)
- Data isolation and auditability (VPC, retention controls, SOC2 evidence)
- Ease of integration with our existing API gateway and Kibana-based observability

High-level POC goals (what we want to learn):
1) Can Redwood hit 95th percentile conversational latency < 200ms at ~200 req/s for short prompts?
2) Is there an integration path that preserves PII controls and audit logs?
3) How much unit-cost improvement do we see with Redwood's batching/caching on our workload?

Tentative timeline: 4-6 weeks. We need an outline from you with measurable success criteria and what you need from our side (sample payloads, traffic patterns, access). Also please call out who on Redwood will own engineering/SE touchpoints.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Ng
Head of AI Platform, SparkBank
alice@sparkbank.com
[Attachment: none]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Ng <alice@sparkbank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo follow-up: Redwood inference fit?

Hi Alice — appreciated the time today. Per your ask, attached is a concise POC outline that maps goals to measurable success criteria, a suggested 6-week timeline, and owner assignments. High level here first; attachment has the detailed milestones.

POC summary (quick):
- Objective: Validate performance, cost, and security controls running a conversational customer support flow against a sandbox of SparkBank traffic.
- Scope: 2 variants of the model (redwood-compat-7b quantized + a 13b baseline), 1 load pattern (200 rps sustained, 400 rps bursts), and a synthetic dataset + 2 days of replay from your sandbox.

Success criteria (measurable):
- Performance: 95th percentile latency for typical turns < 200ms at 200 req/s (measured over 1h sustained window)
- Reliability: <1% error rate and no more than two rolling restarts in a 24h window
- Cost: per-token inference cost projected to be <= $0.0009 per token for production-like mix (will refine after initial runs)
- Security: Network isolation via VPC peering, request-level audit logs ingested into your Kibana instance, and encrypted-at-rest model artifacts

6-week milestone plan (week -> owner):
- Week 0: Kickoff + access provisioning (SparkBank infra + Redwood SE) -> Owner: Ben / Alice
- Week 1: Integration + sample data ingestion -> Owner: Priyom
- Week 2: Baseline runs (13b) + perf tuning -> Owner: Priyom
- Week 3: Quantized model runs + caching/batching experiments -> Owner: Priyom
- Week 4: Reliability/chaos tests + logging validation -> Owner: Evelyn
- Week 5: Cost analysis + final run -> Owner: Ben
- Week 6: Final review, recommendation, and next-step proposal -> Owner: Ben / Alice

What we need from SparkBank today:
- Sandbox access or sample payloads (anonymized) and expected traffic profile (RPS distribution)
- Contact for network/VPC setup (security/infra person)
- Confirmation whether you prefer a 4-week accelerated POC or the proposed 6-week plan

Attaching: poc-outline-sparkbank.pdf (contains detailed runbooks and measurement templates). If that looks good I can schedule a 30-min kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

- Success criteria: keep the 95p < 200ms target but we'd like an additional end-to-end latency figure (API gateway -> model -> response) with synthetic traffic.
- Legal note: our procurement team needs a Non-Disclosure & Technical Addendum (NTA) and a DPA; I'm looping Legal above. Please send a short NTA early in the week.

On the timeline: if Redwood can confirm SE availability next week (Priyom), we'll target an April 1 kickoff and a 4-week window.
